d:
Koondukulla Video Song from Chinna Gounder Tamil Movie exclusively on Pyramid Glitz Music. Chinna Gounder ft. Vijayakanth and Sukanya in lead roles. Directed by RV Udayakumar, Music composed by Ilayaraja, Produced by Venu Chettiyar, V Mohan, V Natarajan under the banner Anandhi Films.
Full Details:
Song: Koondukulla
Singers: SP Balasubrahmanyam, S Janaki
Lyrics: RV Udayakumar
Music: Ilayaraja
Director: RV Udayakumar.
Release Date: 14 January 1992
